story_description: As a user managing hooks across multiple CLI tools, I need a provider selector UI in the Hooks Builder so that I can switch between Claude Code, Gemini, and Codex hook configurations and see which events are available for each provider.
task_description: Create ProviderSelectorView.swift with a segmented control allowing users to select the target CLI provider for hook configuration, showing available events per provider and disabling unsupported providers with explanatory tooltips.
atom_description: Implement a segmented picker control at the top of the Hooks Builder interface that allows switching between Claude Code (12 events), Gemini (11 events), and Codex (disabled with tooltip). The selector must update the hook canvas to show only events valid for the selected provider and persist the selection across sessions.
problem_statement: The Hooks Builder currently assumes Claude Code as the only target provider. With multi-CLI support, users need to select which provider they are configuring hooks for. Different providers support different hook events (Claude has 12, Gemini has 11, Codex has its own set). Without a provider selector, users cannot create provider-specific hook configurations or understand which events are available for their target CLI.

risks: Codex may require different disabled UX when its hook format is finalized
Event counts may change as provider hook specs evolve
Segmented picker may not scale if more providers added (4+ segments)
AppStorage key collision if same key used elsewhere
mitigations: Design HookProvider.isEnabled and disabledReason as computed properties that can be updated without UI changes
Make eventCount a computed property that can later call HookEventMapping service
Document that picker redesign needed if provider count exceeds 4
Use unique prefixed key 'hooks_selectedProvider' with project namespace
risk_register.blast_radius: Affects only ProviderSelectorView component and HooksBuilderView parent. No impact on hook execution, settings persistence, or other Settings views. Isolated UI component with clear boundaries.
risk_register.fallback_plan: If provider selector has issues, remove from HooksBuilderView and default to Claude Code only behavior. No data loss as hooks are provider-agnostic in storage, provider targeting is UI-only concern.
